scoring.eyeholeReads: artifacts/forensics/k3-wallclock-r1/eyehole-k3r1.json: 42 cycle windows from release video 38.001 s (HUD first + 2.433 - 0.070) +1.0 s, 2.6 s at 5 fps; 18 identified (10 Withered Chica, 8 Withered Bonnie), 18 empty, 6 unlabelled (3 at hue ~231 sat 0.52, 3 at hue ~45 sat 0.56), 0 Withered Freddy
scoring.firstEncounter: observed Withered Chica in cycle 4; the published top shares were Chica@2 33%, Bonnie@3 25%, Freddy@2 21%, Chica@3 17% -- the observed first encounter was not among them
scoring.allSeedMatch: scored against every k3 seed (seq-shard.mjs over 1..65536): 2 seeds match all 18 reads with no conflict (57558, 48318), 16 match 17; median seed 5 hits
scoring.impliedLoadGaps: from the phone wall onset: 57558 -> 25 570 ms, 48318 -> 34 810 ms before the onset; three 17-hit seeds fall inside 0-6 900 ms (361, 1213, 6865 ms), which 16 candidates would do by chance most of the time
scoring.verdict: The prediction is not supported: its first-encounter call missed and no strong seed sits inside the load-gap window it assumed.

seedClockTest.nightLoadSeeding: expects a gap of 0 to ~6.9 s (the preset tap sits 6.83-6.95 s before the onset in r01b, r03, r05, k3; the start tap follows it and is not logged). Neither k3's perfect matches (25.6 s, 34.8 s) nor r03's best seeds (9.5, 27.6, 29.0, 44.2, 50.1 s, host-mapped with the phone at -1401/-1350 ms) land there.
seedClockTest.earlierLoadSeeding: checked: no logged event in either run lines up with a perfect-match gap; k3's gaps fall 1.4 s and 10.6 s after its launch and before the campaign log starts, r03's 6.9-8.3 s after its launch or before it -- no common event type
seedClockTest.whyTheObservableFails: the right-eyehole reader never sees Withered Freddy (27.9% of model encounters), leaves 2-6 reads unlabelled per run, and near-duplicate encounter schedules across seeds leave several seeds tied at the top (r03: 5 seeds at 19/21, k3: 2 at 18/18)

reopened.why: The model used for this prediction and its scoring lacked g744's per-second decide path draw (one global RNG draw per second), so every candidate's predicted night ran on a random stream out of step with the game's from the first second, and it predicted W. Freddy encounters the phone does not have (docs/evidence/withered-freddy-route-night7-20260915.json). A 'not supported' verdict from that model is not evidence against clock seeding.
reopened.rescoreWithRouteFixOn: k3 run 1's 18 eyehole reads against all 65,536 seeds with sourcedRouteForks on: 7 seeds at 17/18 hits, 26 at 16, median 5; none of the 17-hit seeds implies a load gap inside 0-6.9 s; the best in-window seeds score 16 (gaps 2480 and 2612 ms, rank 30), which 33 seeds at >=16 hits would reach by chance ~97% of the time. Still inconclusive.
